purpose: Unified covers for blog posts and six indie projects, shared by light and dark website themes

common.safeArea: Keep critical content within central 76% width and 76% height; leave at least 8% outer breathing room
common.composition: One primary metaphor, at most three secondary elements; primary subject spans 45–65% of image width
common.text: No generated headlines, dates, badges, UI labels or watermarks; website renders titles as HTML
common.themes: Use identical cover in both themes; avoid pure-white full fields, pure-black full fields, outer glows and theme-specific recoloring
common.existingIcon: Preserve original icon geometry, wordmark and colors. Generate setting separately, then composite original asset without AI redrawing it. Reserve logo zone in prompt.
common.existingScreenshot: Preserve actual UI and its text; use original image as a clean inset or scene within the common frame, without asking AI to invent UI
common.noAsset: Use a concept illustration, explicitly not a new official logo or invented product screenshot
common.article: Extract a concrete central claim from the article body, create one visual metaphor, avoid literal title illustration when misleading
common.reference: After selection approve three master covers: article, project with identity asset, project without identity asset. Supply those as style references for future generation. Prompts alone do not guarantee consistency.

styles.name: 柔质物件
styles.geometry: Precise rounded solids; 3/4 orthographic camera; one main object and one clear spatial relationship
styles.materials: Matte resin as primary material; frosted acrylic as optional secondary material; no metallic chrome or glass rainbow
styles.lighting: Large soft upper-left key light; short grounded down-right shadows; constant camera distance
styles.strength: Modern product presentation; can visually bridge everyday apps and developer tools
styles.risk: Common in current product illustration; needs distinctive metaphors to avoid interchangeable plastic objects
styles.promptSuffix: 柔质微缩物件风格。主材质为哑光树脂，辅助材质最多一种磨砂亚克力；固定四分之三正交视角，左上大面积柔光，右下短接触阴影。使用指定色板中的一个底色、一个主色和一个点缀色。主体精确、克制、有实体感，不出现玩具表情、炫彩玻璃、霓虹或镀铬材质。

styles.name: 几何版画
styles.geometry: Large flat silhouettes; one dominant geometric relationship; balanced asymmetry
styles.materials: Two ink colors plus one paper ground; restrained uniform fine print grain
styles.lighting: Flat, no physical lighting; no extrusion, gradients or cast shadows
styles.strength: Strong editorial identity; readable at small size; suitable for repeated article covers
styles.risk: Existing colorful app icons need careful staging on an otherwise restrained palette; less screenshot-led
styles.promptSuffix: 当代几何丝网版画。一个平面背景，加两种油墨色；大色块与清晰轮廓，轻微且均匀的细颗粒纸感，非对称但平衡的构图。无立体挤出、无渐变、无物理投影、无贴纸和装饰标签。图形应在小尺寸下仍有强烈轮廓。原有品牌图标作为保真例外，禁止改色或重画。

styles.name: 纸雕浅浮层
styles.geometry: Top-down view; three to five precision-cut layers; shallow consistent depth; generous negative space
styles.materials: Fine matte colored paper with subtle visible fibers; no torn edges or scrapbook accessories
styles.lighting: Soft upper-left light; shallow down-right contact shadows; no deep diorama perspective
styles.strength: Balances warmth and precision; adds tactility without dominating a reading-oriented site
styles.risk: Can become childish or decorative unless subject count, layer count and saturation remain controlled
styles.promptSuffix: 精密纸雕浅浮层插画。固定俯视视角，三至五层哑光彩纸，轻微纸纤维和干净裁切边缘，左上柔光，右下浅接触阴影，整体深度克制。使用指定低饱和色板，主体层与背景有清晰明度差。无撕纸、胶带、手写字、花边、贴纸、儿童卡通脸或复杂微缩场景。

basePrompt: 为 SandyKid 网站绘制一张文章或项目封面。内容类型：{文章/有图标项目/有截图项目/无素材项目}。内容摘要：{基于原文的2至3句摘要}。核心观点：{读者应理解的一句话}。视觉隐喻：{一个具体物件关系}。参考素材角色：{风格参考/必须保真的原始图标/原始截图/无}。使用已选视觉规范：{styleSuffix}。构图为16:9，单一主体占画面宽度45%至65%，重要元素位于中央76%区域，四周至少留8%呼吸空间。最多三个辅助元素。指定底色：{ground}；主色：{primary}；点缀色：{accent}。无标题、日期、品牌自造文字、水印和边框。不要虚构产品界面或官方标志。有图标时仅生成场景并预留{位置}，原图标后期保真合成。

exampleMetaphors.AI Agent 安全与防护策略: A branching agent path crossing a controlled gate, illustrating access boundaries rather than total safety
exampleMetaphors.AI Agent 与硬件: A software module connecting to a tangible mechanical interface, emphasizing contact with the physical world
exampleMetaphors.当代码越来越便宜: Many identical code blocks around one carefully fitted joint, contrasting abundant code with scarce design judgment
exampleMetaphors.Wallpaper-shift: The same landscape across dawn, sunset and night panels
exampleMetaphors.Xiaobai: Two complementary pieces connecting through three stepping stones
exampleMetaphors.evk: Two containers sharing a single set of keys without scattering copies
exampleMetaphors.Konbini: Use the actual store scene as the recognizable subject; no generic replacement convenience store
